name: Edward J. Alvarez
office: City of Azusa, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Edward J. Alvarez has served on the five-member Azusa City Council since he was first elected in March 2013, and was re-elected in 2017 and 2022. He is running for re-election to the council in 2026, and works as a federal auditor.

sentences.text: Edward J. Alvarez has served on the five-member Azusa City Council since he was first elected in March 2013, and was re-elected in 2017 and 2022.
He is running for re-election to the council in 2026, and works as a federal auditor.

items.text: In June 2026, Alvarez and the council unanimously adopted an $84.6 million operating budget backed by $52 million in general fund reserves, adding $6.25 million for capital projects like renovations to the senior center, library, and Civic Center. He says that when he was first elected, the city had zero reserves and a $32,000 surplus.
